name: logicflower
description: LogicFlower multi-tenant workflow operations, monitoring and batch automation SaaS

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run guardrails && npm run lint:security
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.verify: npm run guardrails && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
